title: Sr                     <sub>2</sub>                     LaAlTiO                     <sub>7</sub>                     : a new Ruddlesden–Popper compound with excellent microwave dielectric properties
abstract: A new                     n                     = 2 type Ruddlesden–Popper compound Sr                     2                     LaAlTiO                     7                     was synthesized and characterized, and the microwave dielectric properties were investigated together with their microstructures.
